story.title: The Stolen Second
story.logline: A man discovers he can buy extra time by paying with his happy memories, until he runs out of joy.
story.theme: The true cost of avoiding pain is losing happiness.
story.twist: The memories he sold to buy extra time were the very moments that made life worth living.
story.ending: Would you trade your happiest day for one more minute of breathing?

scenes.narration: My watch showed midnight, but the street was frozen mid-stride, locked in a breathless, terrifying silence.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn green hoodie, stands in a city street where people are literally frozen in place. Moody urban night, vertical 9:16 framing.
scenes.camera: Static wide shot capturing the frozen crowd.

scenes.narration: I did this. I bought this extra second using a kiosk that trades my happy memories for time.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy dark hair, green hoodie, standing before a glowing metallic kiosk with a fingerprint scanner in a dark alleyway. Vertical 9:16 framing.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up tracking Leo's nervous hands.

scenes.narration: Ten seconds cost my first kiss. A minute cost my graduation day. It felt like a fair trade.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy dark hair, green hoodie, looking down at his palm as faint glowing golden particles drift away into the dark alley. Vertical 9:16 framing.
scenes.camera: Close-up on Leo's hand and glowing particles.

scenes.narration: The world around me unfroze, people rushing past me unaware that I had stolen a slice of their universe.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy dark hair, green hoodie, standing as commuters suddenly surge past him in fast motion. Vertical 9:16 framing.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder tracking shot moving with Leo.

scenes.narration: Then the chest pain hit, sharp and relentless. My heart demanded payment for the stolen seconds I abused.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy dark hair, green hoodie, gripping his chest in pain against a brick wall under a flickering streetlamp. Vertical 9:16 framing.
scenes.camera: Handheld close-up on Leo's strained face.

scenes.narration: I ran back to the alley kiosk, desperate to buy another minute before my heart gave out completely.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy dark hair, green hoodie, stumbling frantically down a narrow, shadowy brick alley toward the glowing machine. Vertical 9:16 framing.
scenes.camera: Low angle tracking shot running backward.

scenes.narration: The screen flashed red. Account empty. No more happy memories left to trade for your life.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy dark hair, green hoodie, staring wide-eyed at the kiosk screen displaying a glaring red error message. Vertical 9:16 framing.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Leo's terrified eyes reflecting the red light.

scenes.narration: My mind flooded with emptiness. Not just sadness, but a hollow void where my entire life should be.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy dark hair, green hoodie, sinking to his knees in the alley, clutching his head as the world blurs. Vertical 9:16 framing.
scenes.camera: High angle spinning shot looking down at Leo.

scenes.narration: I had bought so much time that I forgot what I was trying to stay alive for.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy dark hair, green hoodie, sitting blankly against the alley wall, tears falling without a reason. Vertical 9:16 framing.
scenes.camera: Static medium shot focusing on his expressionless face.

scenes.narration: Would you trade your happiest day for one more minute of breathing?
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy dark hair, green hoodie, staring directly into the camera lens with dead, hollow eyes in the dark alley. Vertical 9:16 framing.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up, locked off and unblinking.

caption.hook: Buy more time. Sell your joy.
caption.title: The Stolen Second
caption.caption:
He traded his happiest moments just to live a little longer. But when the joy is gone, what is left to save?

Would you pay with your best memories just to cheat the clock?
